subject: maths
question: Vignesh spends 42% of his monthly salary on food, 16% on house rent, 11% on entertainment and 7% on conveyance. But due to some family function, he has to borrow Rs. 12,000 from a money leader to meet the expenses of Rs. 18,000 What is his monthly salary?
solution:
Given:

Spends on food = 42% of monthly salary

Spends on house rent = 16% of monthly salary

Spends on entertainment = 11% of monthly salary

Spends on conveyance = 7% of monthly salary

Borrowed Rs. 12,000 to meet the expenses of Rs. 18,000.

Calculation:

Let, the monthly salary of Vignesh = 100 %

Percentage of salary left after all expenditure

⇒ 100% - (42 + 16 + 11 + 7)%

⇒ 100% - 76% = 24%

Before borrowing, he had left with

⇒ 18,000 - 12,000 = Rs. 6,000

Now,

24% of his salary = Rs. 6000

100% of his salary = 6000/24 × 100 = Rs. 25,000

∴ His salary is Rs. 25,000.
